description_en: Queries the details of an API security event
description_zh: 查询API安全事件详细信息
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-apisec-event-detail --instance-id waf_elasticity-cn-0xldbqtm005 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --event-id 18ba94fea9000e66ba0557b7b91 --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeApisecEventDetail

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the API security event
parameters.name: event_id

parameters.help_en: The dimension of the security event
parameters.name: event_scope

parameters.help_en: The type of detailed information about the security event
parameters.help_zh: 安全事件的详细信息类型
parameters.name: detail_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the hybrid cloud cluster.
This parameter applies only to hybrid cloud scenarios. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html operation to query hybrid cloud cluster information
parameters.help_zh:
混合云集群 ID。
只针对混合云场景，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2849376.html获取混合云集群信息
parameters.name: cluster_id

items.description_en:
The attacker information.
If EventScope is set to ip, this value is the attacker IP address. If EventScope is set to account, this value is the attacker account
items.description_zh:
攻击者信息。
当安全事件的维度 EventScope 取值为 ip 时，为攻击者IP，取值为 account 时，为攻击者账号
